phil.qwen_reference_text: Well, Jim, that's the thing about a good idea. It usually sounds a little crazy right up until somebody actually builds it. Then everybody wonders why we weren't doing it that way all along.
phil.qwen_voice_instruction: Phil Dandy: curious, energetic younger-brother host; warm, quick, conversational cadence.

jim.qwen_reference_text: Phil, that sounds good on paper, but I want to know what happens when somebody actually has to use it. If it saves money, makes sense, and doesn't create three new problems, then you've got my attention.
jim.qwen_voice_instruction: Jim Dandy: grounded, practical older-brother host; dry, measured, skeptical, clear.

bryan.qwen_voice_instruction: Bryan, the off-mic producer in the background: natural, conversational, occasionally amused or exasperated by the show noise.

producer_background.instruction: Bryan is the off-mic producer physically in the room. Speak softly, briefly, and from a slight distance. React only to studio activity or when Phil or Jim addresses you. Do not explain the episode topic.

producer_on_mic.instruction: Bryan is intentionally on mic for a special announcement or producer segment. Speak clearly and naturally as the producer, without becoming a regular host.
